About

Product Projection is an interactive holodeck for exploring lululemon fabrics as living material — orbit, light, deform, recolour, and dress them in weather.

Navigate

Drag anywhere to orbit. Use the Zoom slider (left) or scroll/pinch to move in and out — zoom all the way out for a gallery of every swatch, then tap one to select it. The Roll slider (right) spins the product; the Tilt pad (top-right) leans it in 3D.

Grab it

Click-drag directly on the fabric to stretch and pull it like real stretch knit — it springs back when you let go.

Panels

Image — step through swatches (Prev / Next), load your own image, or Wrap the fabric onto a cylinder, sphere, torus or knot.
Background — swap between HDRI skies, the black void, load your own equirectangular image, or cycle the holodeck Grid (Full / Half / Low / None).
Weather — clear, rain, snow, overcast, fog or storm, with an Intensity slider.
Wind — wind, flutter, drape, ripple, twist and more, with presets from calm to storm-force cloth.
Material — depth, shininess, roughness, metalness and specular, plus Hue / Saturation / Brightness recolour, with lululemon fabric presets (Nulu, Luxtreme, Foil…).
Filters — bloom, vignette, grain, background blur and colour grade.
Camera — motion presets: static, auto-orbit, sway, bob, dolly or spiral.

Capture & play

Use the icons up top to reset the experience, save a screenshot, randomize a whole new look, or open this about panel.

Swatches are shown as pinked fabric samples. Fabric swatches and imagery are lululemon references used for demonstration.
